en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large, ornate, ivy‑covered villa or small palace on a wooded hillside. The central building has a tall, decorative tower with pinnacles and Gothic‑revival details, flanked by wings with arched loggias and domed or balustraded roofs. In front is a terraced garden with paths, low stone walls, small trees and shrubs. To the far left stands a separate, older-looking round masonry tower or ruin partly hidden by trees. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century postcard view of a romantic castle-like residence set in landscaped grounds.
